what_it_does: D3DX9 HLSL compiler: recursive code generation/constant folding for one expression tree node (float path); emits the 'tex1D ... texcoord not declared as at least float2' and "intrinsic function '%s' is not yet implemented" diagnostics and mutually recurses with 0x5cb0f7.

D3DX9 HLSL compiler expression emitter that lowers an expression node to shader instructions; source of 'internal error: unrecognized expression', 'internal error: result register invalid' and array-reference diagnostics.

Walks the eight control-device slots and the player's key/mouse/gamepad binding table, converting raw DirectInput state into the per-tick game control button/axis state (analog axes clamped to +/-1); sits in the input run with the key-binding and DirectInput code at 0x48b750-0x490f20.

Builds a decal's clipped polygon geometry: picks a random rotation about the decal normal, walks the decal-type chain, and clips the quad against surfaces into very large temporary vertex/index buffers (~84KB of stack).

Selects and plays an AI dialogue line: resolves speaker and subject actors (0x724-byte actor records), maps unit type to a species bit-mask, consults the 10x10 actor-type relationship bit table, and picks the vocalization/variant to speak.

Main transparent-geometry group draw loop: sets blend function, z-bias, skinning and frustum state per shader pass, evaluates periodic functions and texture animations, then submits the group's vertices.

Formats the multiplayer game-variant rules summary (oddball/race/teamplay/vehicle/item options) into a wide-char string from ui\shell string-list tags, for the join-game browser and playlist edit screens.

Per-tick biped movement/collision update: builds the ground-plane basis from the biped's forward/up vectors and contact normal, integrates velocity, and resolves the move against the world using a ~44KB temporary collision buffer.

Builds an object's full per-node transform array (0x130 bytes per node) from its model tag's node hierarchy plus animation/aiming deltas; the widest of the node-matrix variants dispatched by 0x507840.
D3DX9 HLSL compiler back-end pass that allocates and links an instruction/operand list (heavy operator new/free against the 0x5e2xxx list helpers).
D3DX9 HLSL compiler internal pass that walks and rebuilds a symbol/constant list using the shared 0x5e2xxx list primitives and the double-precision constant pool.

Double-precision constant-expression evaluator for the D3DX9 shader/preshader compiler (same node layout as 0x5c5129); emits 'indefinite acos', 'division by zero', 'infinite/indefinite log', 'imaginary square root' diagnostics.
Per-tick unit update driven from the player/actor code: refreshes aiming and desired-facing vectors, control and seat flags, animation/emotion state and the default 'stand' animation.

Shatters a breakable structure-BSP surface once its health reaches zero (called from 0x4ffde0): flood-fills the connected surface set, projects each polygon into the surface plane's 2D basis, and spawns the shard geometry plus a break effect via effect_new (0x549af0).

Evaluates an AI actor's perceived targets/props (0x138-byte prop records) and candidate firing positions with BSP visibility queries, fills a large (~1.6KB) combat-status record and returns the chosen index, or 0xffffffff.
D3DX9 HLSL compiler register allocation/vectorization pass; emits 'program too complex: out of temporary registers' and 'internal error: unvectorized register found'.

Hardware-capability-selected draw path for structure BSP shader_environment (detail/reflection combiner modes, camera distance fade, periodic function and texture animation evaluation); installed into the rasterizer draw function-pointer table by 0x52b630.
MMX/SIMD-optimized D3DX math routine (7 pointer args, 64-bit packed operands) installed into the CPU-feature-dispatched math function table built at 0x5bfc1b.

Draws the multiplayer team score HUD/scoreboard, loading the ui\shell team icon bitmaps (ctf/king/oddball/race/slayer) and team background; lives in the HUD run with hud_message and hud_render_nav_points.
Second MMX/SIMD-optimized D3DX math routine with the same 7-pointer signature as 0x5dd43f, selected by the CPU-feature dispatch table at 0x5bfc1b.
